column1: # What a change touches: which checks scripts/mdmm-check.sh runs for it (doc/release/DEV-CYCLE.md). One row per path
# pattern, read top to bottom: the first row a path matches is the one for it.
#   path      a glob on the path from the checkout (* any run of characters, also /)
#   ctest     unit tests: a ctest -R regex, or L:<label> (L:Page: the node page tests), or "all" (every unit test)
#   firmware  firmware tests for the branch check (ctest -R regex; they need the ROMs)
#   page      page journeys (scripts/mdmm-page.mjs selector: md-*, mm-*, * both editors)
#   machine   machine journeys for the branch check (scripts/mdmm-journeys.sh --tier machine selector, ROMs needed)
#   goldens   yes: the change can change the sound (emulation code): the playing goldens run
#   gate      the local gate's stages a release runs for it on top of the last green full gate on main
#             (scripts/mdmm-full-gate.sh --plan; MDMM_GATE_ONLY), "all" for every stage; stage 1, the build, always runs
# A path no row matches runs every unit test and every page journey (the safe default), and every gate stage.
# --- the design sources: the canonical files the page files are generated from (doc/modern-ux/sync-*-skin.py). Before
# the skin rows and the doc/* row, so a source takes the tests and journeys of the page it makes. A source file of one
# area (its journeys are named <editor>-<area>-*, skins/shared/deskJourney.js) runs that area's journeys; a shared or
# cross-cutting one, and every stylesheet (any view can change), runs the machine's page journeys.
# --- the generated page files: the sync scripts' --check (the page contract, which runs for any change under skins/) proves they
# are in step with the sources above, so the sources carry the tests; a hand edit that is not in a source fails the check
# --- the core and the machines' models (no emulator)
# --- the plug-in (JUCE, the window, the host side)
# --- what holds no code the tests run
# the preview's scenarios (doc/modern-ux/scenarios): checked against the contract, no ROM, no browser
